invariants.rationale: Alpha blending parameters are usually clamped between 0 and 1 for rendering transparency.
Typical rendering pipelines require a non-null Batch object to draw.
Rendering code expects the alpha parameter to be a valid number, not NaN.
getColor() is called in the method; presumes it returns a non-null Color for proper rendering.
Widget/component widths in UIs are usually non-negative.
